name: safety-governance
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when trust-ladder / budget enforcement moves into a different layer than a project-local central config (config.json) consulted at tick entry, or when the config schema reaches its next breaking major (3.0.0).
spec_change_reason: Add the pure helper issue_filter_apply_labels(config) -> list[str]: the labels a loop-FILED discovery issue must carry to be re-pullable by a later label-filtered PULL, namely the FIRST non-empty AND-group of the normalized issue_filter.labels (carrying one full AND-group satisfies the whole DNF), or [] when issue_filter has no labels. It reuses the existing issue_filter(config) normalizer; pure, no I/O. GOVERNANCE_SCHEMA_VERSION UNCHANGED (2.8.0) — accessor only, no new config field. Label dimension only (title_pattern is not enforced on filed-issue titles, a documented limitation). scheduling resolves it at the REPORT flush and threads it into work-intake's filing sink. The spec sub-bullet + contract accessor entry were committed in cb35896; this cycle implements the code+tests and re-anchors the housekeep doc-baseline floor 454->468 for the legitimate spec growth.
spec_no_change_reason: spec for issue_filter exclude_labels + --issue-exclude-labels already committed in 84958b5 prior to this test-write cycle
